mathematical_or_operational_scope: Finite-field construction of the n=8 lower-column 4x4 spectral-minor polynomial on the six-variable chart.
positive_controls: Lines 24–46 construct the determinant from Fourier templates, scaling the lower-generator column by t*(root-1). Lines 69–71 compare it with a directly evaluated unscaled determinant.

findings.issue: All random build failures may be skipped, and validate still returns with verified=0, example=None and a polynomial. There is no minimum successful-comparison assertion.

Callable APIs accept arbitrary modulus/root without checking prime field status or exact eighth-root order. Their mathematical interpretation is guaranteed only under separately supplied preconditions.

The actual C-column and first-column Fourier vectors are computed but never used. The checked determinant is built from templates; this does not check their full candidate proportionality or all factorization equations.

The introductory F8=BPC phrase conflicts with the repository convention F8=BPA, C=A^-1. The operative matrix construction corresponds to the latter convention; treat the prose as an orientation typo, not a new factorization definition.

cost_and_scaling: Constant 24-term determinant at n=8, with sparse polynomial expansion and fixed-size modular matrices. Not an all-size factorization or FFT runtime claim.
test_scope_and_limits: At most 15 usable comparisons per prime/root pair, four pairs in main. A nonzero polynomial assertion and exact modular scaling checks are intended, but were not executed.
certificate_acceptance: Necessary spectral-minor obstruction only. A zero determinant does not reconstruct generator coefficients, prove regularity, or establish full Fourier-factorization feasibility.
